declaredStatus.claim: The SDK root is a dependency-free shared ESM entry containing DTOs, compatibility and explicit ports; Schema validators and Node verification have separate entries. S11-S15 are declared implemented, while native target admission is separate from compatibility.
declaredStatus.evidenceLimit: Only root ownership, import graph and negotiation are accepted here; declarations about other SDK entries or native execution remain unreviewed.

checks.question: Does the root expose public DTOs/ports without reverse package/runtime dependencies?
checks.detail: No production dependency is declared. Root runtime imports are local registry/negotiate/error modules; DTOs, ports and the music provider reference are type-only. ES2023/types=[] compilation and independent installed-consumer typing pass. No source/core/UI/app/framework runtime is imported.

checks.question: Is the emitted and installed root entry lightweight?
checks.detail: Installed root/music imports pass with dynamic string code generation disabled. The dedicated emitted-root graph contains exactly index.js, generated/registry.js, negotiate.js and plugin-call-error.js; no Schema validator, Node verifier, Vue, source implementation or VM engine is loaded. Full production application graphs remain separate evidence.

checks.question: Does compatibility negotiation reject incompatible required inputs and distinguish optional omissions?
checks.detail: Four retained negotiation tests and the 30-case temporary probe pass. The latter checks SDK inclusive/exclusive bounds and invalid semver, six host version dimensions, current wire intersection, required/optional capability availability and unknown/future capabilities even when advertised by the host, required/optional contributions, forms and execution policy. Inputs are decoded/validated before negotiation. VM lifecycle implementation is outside this pure synchronous chain.

checks.question: Are errors and named ports independent from core/business/native authority?
checks.detail: PluginCallError carries the generated WireError DTO without importing core. Named state/network/digest and executor session methods are injected; there is no arbitrary invoke bridge, transport or authority implementation. Negotiation returns version/capability metadata, with nonretryable refusal errors. Native identity/epoch/authorization is explicitly a trusted channel responsibility. This does not prove native authorization or actual termination.
